g.text: Signal Area Estimation based on Deep Learning (2023), Figure 16a, AWGN channel
Published curves are digitized approximations from the author manuscript, not raw measurements.
Local curves use mean per-image foreground pixel F1. Datasets, training and averaging protocols are not fully matched.
* Historical FCNN: separate 312,000-image test set; the three newer models share 20,800 test images.
Paper Option 3 uses all training SNRs; Option 4 additionally receives SNR as an input. DOI: 10.1016/j.phycom.2023.102113
